content.short: Good Games Guild is a Web3 gaming guild and DAO that scouts, onboards, and invests in blockchain games and players on Mantle.
content.description: Good Games Guild (GGG) is one of the largest Web3 gaming guilds and DAOs in Southeast Asia, focused on discovering, playing, and investing in blockchain games. The guild scholarships players to participate in play-to-earn games, funds early-stage game development through its investment arm, and builds community around emerging blockchain gaming titles. GGG has expanded its operations to the Mantle ecosystem, supporting gaming projects including ArbiPad and Mantle-native games with community resources and capital.
content.meta: Good Games Guild is a Web3 gaming DAO that scouts and invests in blockchain games on Mantle and beyond. Discover GGG on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
